uutiset.t: Trump posthumously pardons US baseball legend Pete Rose
uutiset.s: Rose, who died in 2024, was given a lifetime ban from the sport for betting on games but was reinstated last year.

uutiset.t: California probing whether China improperly acquired Nvidia technology
uutiset.s: The probe by California, where the AI chipmaker has its global headquarters, follows former CEO Jensen Huang's departure.

uutiset.t: From premature baby to social media star - Famed hippo Fiona dies
uutiset.s: The beloved hippopotamus died days after swallowing a knitted hat that accidentally got into her enclosure at the Cincinnati Zoo.

uutiset.t: Judge finds Thomas Markle mentally fit to stand trial on child abuse charges
uutiset.s: Markle, who has denied possessing images of child sex abuse was deemed competent after an evaluation by a court-appointed psychiatrist.

uutiset.t: Fiona the hippo dies after swallowing a hat at Cincinnati Zoo
uutiset.s: Fiona, who became an internet star after her premature birth in 2017, "fought until she couldn’t anymore", the zoo says.

uutiset.t: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut
uutiset.s: Anthropic is the first purely AI company to be publicly listed, creating a test for the entire industry.

uutiset.t: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
uutiset.s: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

uutiset.t: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
uutiset.s: The unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.

uutiset.t: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
uutiset.s: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.

uutiset.t: Rohingya genocide: What was said in court and what happens now?
uutiset.s: The verdict marks the first time a state has ever been found to have committed genocide by an international court.

uutiset.t: Susan Smith denied parole again 32 years after drowning her two sons
uutiset.s: At a hearing on the possibility of parole, Smith said she wished she could change the past, and her two children "did not deserve to die".

uutiset.t: BBC correspondents discuss what Trump, Xi and Putin got out of historic talks
uutiset.s: Trump, Putin and Xi have issued a "joint declaration of peace" after historical trilateral talks, but what did they get out of meeting?

uutiset.t: Israeli military completes ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
uutiset.s: Hamas condemned the incursion, which the Israeli military said was to dismantle a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.

uutiset.t: Dozens missing after boat carrying migrants sinks off Senegal's coast
uutiset.s: At least four bodies have been recovered from the boat which was reportedly carrying between 50 and 100 people.

uutiset.t: Venezuela signs military deal with US less than a year after Maduro's removal
uutiset.s: The US Secretary of Defence says Venezuela has "gone from our most aggressive regional threat to a compliant security partner".
